description:
Use this when the user wants the thumbnail or cover of a draft post chosen: "use the moment at 12 seconds as
the thumbnail", "put this picture as the YouTube thumbnail". Give one of at_seconds, image_url or remove.
Works on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram drafts; TikTok takes at_seconds only; Threads and Bluesky choose
their own. Replaces the earlier cover.
Not for: scheduled or posted posts (refused) or other draft details (update_draft). Free.

at_seconds.description: Use the clip frame at this many seconds from the clip start, 0 up to the clip length. Empty for none.

image_url.description: Direct https link to a .jpg, .png or .webp picture, or a Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link. Empty for none.

post_id.description: Id of a draft post, from get_post_stats with status "draft".

remove.description: True removes the draft cover. Give only one of at_seconds, image_url, remove.

name: set_post_cover
title: Set a draft cover
